INSERT OR IGNORE INTO sync_library_revision(id,revision) VALUES(1,0)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_peer_state (peer_device_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,last_local_seq_acked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,last_remote_seq_applied INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,last_full_sync_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,last_protocol_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sync_change_log_entity ON sync_change_log(kind,entity_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS article_reading_state (article_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES articles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, progress REAL NOT NULL, changed_at INTEGER NOT NULL, position_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, position_hash TEXT NOT NULL, state_json TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS article_sync_content (item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES articles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, content_html TEXT, content_text TEXT NOT NULL, body_hash TEXT NOT NULL, body_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, chunk_size INTEGER NOT NULL, chunk_hashes TEXT NOT NULL, content_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS article_sync_encoding_cache (item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES articles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, body_hash TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS article_native_sync_hash (item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES articles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,body_hash TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS offline_media (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES articles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, media_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(media_type IN ('IMAGE','VIDEO')), origin_url TEXT NOT NULL, relative_path TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(item_id,origin_url))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_local_identity (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), device_id TEXT NOT NULL, device_order TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_article_ids (article_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, item_id INTEGER UNIQUE CHECK(item_id>0) REFERENCES articles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, url TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_article_aliases (item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES articles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, article_id TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS sync_article_alias_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF article_id ON sync_article_aliases WHEN OLD.article_id!=NEW.article_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Article alias already bound to another identity'); END
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS sync_article_binding_immutable

CREATE TRIGGER sync_article_binding_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF item_id ON sync_article_ids WHEN OLD.item_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.item_id IS NOT NULL AND OLD.item_id!=NEW.item_id AND NOT (
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sync_article_aliases WHERE item_id=OLD.item_id AND article_id=OLD.article_id) AND
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sync_article_aliases al JOIN articles a ON a.id=al.item_id WHERE al.item_id=NEW.item_id AND al.article_id=NEW.article_id AND a.dedup_key=NEW.article_id AND a.link IS NEW.url)
   ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Article id already bound to another item'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS sync_article_insert_binding_immutable BEFORE INSERT ON sync_article_ids WHEN NEW.item_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sync_article_ids WHERE article_id=NEW.article_id AND item_id IS NOT NULL AND item_id!=NEW.item_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Article id already bound to another item'); END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS article_saved_entry_times (article_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES articles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,save_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(save_type IN ('favorite','watchLater')),created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(article_id,save_type))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_saved_states (article_id TEXT NOT NULL, save_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(save_type IN ('favorite','watchLater')), item_id INTEGER REFERENCES articles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, url TEXT NOT NULL, saved INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(saved IN (0,1)), changed_at INTEGER NOT NULL, sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL, source_device_id TEXT NOT NULL, source_order TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(article_id,save_type))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS local_article_deletions (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, channel_url TEXT NOT NULL, article_url TEXT NOT NULL, dedup_key TEXT NOT NULL, was_favorite INTEGER NOT NULL, was_watch_later INTEGER NOT NULL, changed_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_media_preferences (channel_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES channels(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, continue_in_background INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS article_original_meta (article_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES articles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, source_url TEXT NOT NULL, fetched_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS article_original_chunks (article_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES articles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(article_id,chunk_index))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS channels (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, url TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, title TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, image_url TEXT, last_fetched_at INTEGER, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, is_pinned INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS articles (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES channels(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, title TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, content TEXT, link TEXT, guid TEXT, pub_date TEXT, image_url TEXT, audio_url TEXT, video_url TEXT, is_read INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, is_saved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reading_progress REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, dedup_key TEXT NOT NULL, fetched_at INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(channel_id, dedup_key))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS articles_channel_date ON articles(channel_id, fetched_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS articles_sync_order ON articles(fetched_at DESC,id DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, article_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES articles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, body TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_preferences (channel_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES channels(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, use_original_content INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, read_preset TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS article_body_chunks (article_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES articles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(article_id, chunk_index))

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS article_sync_hash_content_update AFTER UPDATE OF content,description,link ON articles WHEN OLD.content IS NOT NEW.content OR OLD.description IS NOT NEW.description OR OLD.link IS NOT NEW.link BEGIN DELETE FROM article_native_sync_hash WHERE item_id=NEW.id;DELETE FROM article_sync_content WHERE item_id=NEW.id; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS article_sync_hash_article_body_chunks_insert AFTER INSERT ON article_body_chunks BEGIN DELETE FROM article_native_sync_hash WHERE item_id=NEW.article_id;DELETE FROM article_sync_content WHERE item_id=NEW.article_id; END

CREATE TEMP TABLE _wrss_dedup_plan(item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL,old_key TEXT NOT NULL,target_key TEXT NOT NULL,survivor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,affected INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

INSERT INTO _wrss_dedup_plan(item_id,channel_id,old_key,target_key,survivor_id)
   SELECT a.id,a.channel_id,a.dedup_key,
    CASE WHEN length(a.dedup_key)=64 AND lower(a.dedup_key)=a.dedup_key AND a.dedup_key NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND trim(COALESCE(a.guid,''),char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||char(28)||char(29)||char(30)||char(31)||char(32)||char(160)||char(5760)||char(8192)||char(8193)||char(8194)||char(8195)||char(8196)||char(8197)||char(8198)||char(8199)||char(8200)||char(8201)||char(8202)||char(8232)||char(8233)||char(8239)||char(8287)||char(12288))=a.dedup_key THEN a.dedup_key
     WHEN trim(COALESCE(a.guid,''),char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||char(28)||char(29)||char(30)||char(31)||char(32)||char(160)||char(5760)||char(8192)||char(8193)||char(8194)||char(8195)||char(8196)||char(8197)||char(8198)||char(8199)||char(8200)||char(8201)||char(8202)||char(8232)||char(8233)||char(8239)||char(8287)||char(12288))<>'' THEN 'guid:'||trim(COALESCE(a.guid,''),char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||char(28)||char(29)||char(30)||char(31)||char(32)||char(160)||char(5760)||char(8192)||char(8193)||char(8194)||char(8195)||char(8196)||char(8197)||char(8198)||char(8199)||char(8200)||char(8201)||char(8202)||char(8232)||char(8233)||char(8239)||char(8287)||char(12288))
     WHEN a.dedup_key LIKE 'link:%' THEN a.dedup_key
     WHEN trim(COALESCE(a.link,''),char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||char(28)||char(29)||char(30)||char(31)||char(32)||char(160)||char(5760)||char(8192)||char(8193)||char(8194)||char(8195)||char(8196)||char(8197)||char(8198)||char(8199)||char(8200)||char(8201)||char(8202)||char(8232)||char(8233)||char(8239)||char(8287)||char(12288))<>'' THEN 'link:'||trim(COALESCE(a.link,''),char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||char(28)||char(29)||char(30)||char(31)||char(32)||char(160)||char(5760)||char(8192)||char(8193)||char(8194)||char(8195)||char(8196)||char(8197)||char(8198)||char(8199)||char(8200)||char(8201)||char(8202)||char(8232)||char(8233)||char(8239)||char(8287)||char(12288))
     ELSE 'title:'||a.title END,a.id
   FROM articles a JOIN channels c ON c.id=a.channel_id
   WHERE (lower(trim(COALESCE(c.url,''),char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||char(28)||char(29)||char(30)||char(31)||char(32)||char(160)||char(5760)||char(8192)||char(8193)||char(8194)||char(8195)||char(8196)||char(8197)||char(8198)||char(8199)||char(8200)||char(8201)||char(8202)||char(8232)||char(8233)||char(8239)||char(8287)||char(12288))) LIKE 'http://%' OR lower(trim(COALESCE(c.url,''),char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||char(28)||char(29)||char(30)||char(31)||char(32)||char(160)||char(5760)||char(8192)||char(8193)||char(8194)||char(8195)||char(8196)||char(8197)||char(8198)||char(8199)||char(8200)||char(8201)||char(8202)||char(8232)||char(8233)||char(8239)||char(8287)||char(12288))) LIKE 'https://%')
    AND lower(trim(COALESCE(c.url,''),char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||char(28)||char(29)||char(30)||char(31)||char(32)||char(160)||char(5760)||char(8192)||char(8193)||char(8194)||char(8195)||char(8196)||char(8197)||char(8198)||char(8199)||char(8200)||char(8201)||char(8202)||char(8232)||char(8233)||char(8239)||char(8287)||char(12288))) NOT LIKE 'https://watchrss.local/import-content%'
    AND lower(trim(COALESCE(c.url,''),char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||char(28)||char(29)||char(30)||char(31)||char(32)||char(160)||char(5760)||char(8192)||char(8193)||char(8194)||char(8195)||char(8196)||char(8197)||char(8198)||char(8199)||char(8200)||char(8201)||char(8202)||char(8232)||char(8233)||char(8239)||char(8287)||char(12288))) NOT LIKE 'https://watchrss.local/import-epub%'
    AND lower(trim(COALESCE(c.url,''),char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||char(28)||char(29)||char(30)||char(31)||char(32)||char(160)||char(5760)||char(8192)||char(8193)||char(8194)||char(8195)||char(8196)||char(8197)||char(8198)||char(8199)||char(8200)||char(8201)||char(8202)||char(8232)||char(8233)||char(8239)||char(8287)||char(12288))) NOT LIKE 'https://watchrss.local/import-txt-novel%'

UPDATE _wrss_dedup_plan SET target_key=(SELECT p2.target_key FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p2
    JOIN articles a2 ON a2.id=p2.item_id JOIN articles a1 ON a1.id=_wrss_dedup_plan.item_id
    WHERE p2.channel_id=_wrss_dedup_plan.channel_id AND p2.item_id<>_wrss_dedup_plan.item_id
     AND (p2.target_key LIKE 'guid:%' OR p2.target_key LIKE 'link:%' OR p2.target_key LIKE 'title:%')

    ORDER BY CASE WHEN p2.old_key=p2.target_key THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,p2.item_id LIMIT 1)
   WHERE length(old_key)=64 AND lower(old_key)=old_key AND old_key NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p2
    JOIN articles a2 ON a2.id=p2.item_id JOIN articles a1 ON a1.id=_wrss_dedup_plan.item_id
    WHERE p2.channel_id=_wrss_dedup_plan.channel_id AND p2.item_id<>_wrss_dedup_plan.item_id
     AND (p2.target_key LIKE 'guid:%' OR p2.target_key LIKE 'link:%' OR p2.target_key LIKE 'title:%')
     AND trim(COALESCE(a2.link,''),char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||char(28)||char(29)||char(30)||char(31)||char(32)||char(160)||char(5760)||char(8192)||char(8193)||char(8194)||char(8195)||char(8196)||char(8197)||char(8198)||char(8199)||char(8200)||char(8201)||char(8202)||char(8232)||char(8233)||char(8239)||char(8287)||char(12288))<>'' AND trim(COALESCE(a2.link,''),char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||char(28)||char(29)||char(30)||char(31)||char(32)||char(160)||char(5760)||char(8192)||char(8193)||char(8194)||char(8195)||char(8196)||char(8197)||char(8198)||char(8199)||char(8200)||char(8201)||char(8202)||char(8232)||char(8233)||char(8239)||char(8287)||char(12288))=trim(COALESCE(a1.link,''),char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||char(28)||char(29)||char(30)||char(31)||char(32)||char(160)||char(5760)||char(8192)||char(8193)||char(8194)||char(8195)||char(8196)||char(8197)||char(8198)||char(8199)||char(8200)||char(8201)||char(8202)||char(8232)||char(8233)||char(8239)||char(8287)||char(12288)))
CREATE INDEX temp._wrss_dedup_target ON _wrss_dedup_plan(channel_id,target_key)

UPDATE _wrss_dedup_plan SET survivor_id=(SELECT p2.item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p2
    WHERE p2.channel_id=_wrss_dedup_plan.channel_id AND p2.target_key=_wrss_dedup_plan.target_key
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN p2.old_key=p2.target_key THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,p2.item_id LIMIT 1)

UPDATE _wrss_dedup_plan SET affected=1 WHERE survivor_id IN
    (SELECT survivor_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE old_key<>target_key OR item_id<>survivor_id)
CREATE INDEX temp._wrss_dedup_survivor ON _wrss_dedup_plan(survivor_id)
CREATE TEMP TABLE _wrss_identity_candidates(survivor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,article_id TEXT NOT NULL,priority INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(survivor_id,article_id))

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _wrss_identity_candidates SELECT p.survivor_id,x.article_id,
    CASE WHEN x.item_id=p.survivor_id THEN 0 ELSE 2 END FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN sync_article_aliases x ON x.item_id=p.item_id WHERE p.affected=1

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _wrss_identity_candidates SELECT p.survivor_id,x.article_id,
    CASE WHEN x.item_id=p.survivor_id THEN 1 ELSE 3 END FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN sync_article_ids x ON x.item_id=p.item_id WHERE p.affected=1
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _wrss_identity_candidates SELECT p.survivor_id,x.article_id,3 FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN sync_saved_states x ON x.item_id=p.item_id WHERE p.affected=1

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO _wrss_identity_candidates SELECT survivor_id,old_key,4 FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE affected=1 AND length(old_key)=64 AND lower(old_key)=old_key AND old_key NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'

CREATE TEMP TABLE _wrss_identity_choice AS SELECT DISTINCT c.survivor_id,
    (SELECT c2.article_id FROM _wrss_identity_candidates c2 WHERE c2.survivor_id=c.survivor_id ORDER BY c2.priority,c2.article_id LIMIT 1) article_id
    FROM _wrss_identity_candidates c

UPDATE articles SET
    title=COALESCE((SELECT NULLIF(s.title,'') FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN articles s ON s.id=p.item_id WHERE p.survivor_id=articles.id ORDER BY s.fetched_at DESC,s.id DESC LIMIT 1),title),
    description=COALESCE((SELECT s.description FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN articles s ON s.id=p.item_id WHERE p.survivor_id=articles.id AND trim(COALESCE(s.description,''),char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||char(28)||char(29)||char(30)||char(31)||char(32)||char(160)||char(5760)||char(8192)||char(8193)||char(8194)||char(8195)||char(8196)||char(8197)||char(8198)||char(8199)||char(8200)||char(8201)||char(8202)||char(8232)||char(8233)||char(8239)||char(8287)||char(12288))<>'' ORDER BY length(s.description) DESC,s.fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1),description),
    content=COALESCE((SELECT s.content FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN articles s ON s.id=p.item_id WHERE p.survivor_id=articles.id AND trim(COALESCE(s.content,''),char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||char(28)||char(29)||char(30)||char(31)||char(32)||char(160)||char(5760)||char(8192)||char(8193)||char(8194)||char(8195)||char(8196)||char(8197)||char(8198)||char(8199)||char(8200)||char(8201)||char(8202)||char(8232)||char(8233)||char(8239)||char(8287)||char(12288))<>'' ORDER BY length(s.content) DESC,s.fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1),content),
    link=COALESCE(NULLIF(link,''),(SELECT NULLIF(s.link,'') FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN articles s ON s.id=p.item_id WHERE p.survivor_id=articles.id AND trim(COALESCE(s.link,''),char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||char(28)||char(29)||char(30)||char(31)||char(32)||char(160)||char(5760)||char(8192)||char(8193)||char(8194)||char(8195)||char(8196)||char(8197)||char(8198)||char(8199)||char(8200)||char(8201)||char(8202)||char(8232)||char(8233)||char(8239)||char(8287)||char(12288))<>'' ORDER BY s.fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1)),
    guid=COALESCE(NULLIF(guid,''),(SELECT NULLIF(s.guid,'') FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN articles s ON s.id=p.item_id WHERE p.survivor_id=articles.id AND trim(COALESCE(s.guid,''),char(9)||char(10)||char(11)||char(12)||char(13)||char(28)||char(29)||char(30)||char(31)||char(32)||char(160)||char(5760)||char(8192)||char(8193)||char(8194)||char(8195)||char(8196)||char(8197)||char(8198)||char(8199)||char(8200)||char(8201)||char(8202)||char(8232)||char(8233)||char(8239)||char(8287)||char(12288))<>'' ORDER BY s.fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1)),
    pub_date=COALESCE(pub_date,(SELECT s.pub_date FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN articles s ON s.id=p.item_id WHERE p.survivor_id=articles.id AND s.pub_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1)),
    image_url=COALESCE(image_url,(SELECT s.image_url FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN articles s ON s.id=p.item_id WHERE p.survivor_id=articles.id AND s.image_url IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1)),
    audio_url=COALESCE(audio_url,(SELECT s.audio_url FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN articles s ON s.id=p.item_id WHERE p.survivor_id=articles.id AND s.audio_url IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1)),
    video_url=COALESCE(video_url,(SELECT s.video_url FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN articles s ON s.id=p.item_id WHERE p.survivor_id=articles.id AND s.video_url IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1)),
    is_read=(SELECT max(s.is_read) FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN articles s ON s.id=p.item_id WHERE p.survivor_id=articles.id),
    is_saved=(SELECT max(s.is_saved) FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN articles s ON s.id=p.item_id WHERE p.survivor_id=articles.id),
    reading_progress=(SELECT max(s.reading_progress) FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN articles s ON s.id=p.item_id WHERE p.survivor_id=articles.id),
    fetched_at=(SELECT max(s.fetched_at) FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN articles s ON s.id=p.item_id WHERE p.survivor_id=articles.id)
   WHERE id IN(SELECT survivor_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE affected=1)

CREATE TEMP TABLE _wrss_reading_copy AS SELECT p.survivor_id,r.progress,r.changed_at,r.position_bytes,r.position_hash,r.state_json
   FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN article_reading_state r ON r.article_id=p.item_id
   WHERE p.item_id=(SELECT p2.item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p2 JOIN article_reading_state r2 ON r2.article_id=p2.item_id
    WHERE p2.survivor_id=p.survivor_id ORDER BY r2.changed_at DESC,CASE WHEN r2.changed_at=0 THEN r2.progress ELSE 0 END DESC,CASE WHEN p2.item_id=p2.survivor_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,p2.item_id LIMIT 1)
    AND p.affected=1

CREATE TEMP TABLE _wrss_saved_winners AS SELECT DISTINCT p.survivor_id,s.save_type,
    (SELECT s2.article_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p2 JOIN article_saved_states s2 ON s2.article_id=p2.item_id
     WHERE p2.survivor_id=p.survivor_id AND s2.save_type=s.save_type ORDER BY s2.changed_at DESC,s2.saved DESC,s2.article_id DESC LIMIT 1) source_id
   FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN article_saved_states s ON s.article_id=p.item_id WHERE p.affected=1

CREATE TEMP TABLE _wrss_saved_copy AS SELECT w.survivor_id,s.save_type,s.saved,s.changed_at,s.sort_order
   FROM _wrss_saved_winners w JOIN article_saved_states s ON s.article_id=w.source_id AND s.save_type=w.save_type

CREATE TEMP TABLE _wrss_saved_time_copy AS SELECT p.survivor_id,t.save_type,min(t.created_at) created_at
   FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN article_saved_entry_times t ON t.article_id=p.item_id WHERE p.affected=1 GROUP BY p.survivor_id,t.save_type

CREATE TEMP TABLE _wrss_body_copy AS SELECT g.survivor_id,b.chunk_index,b.body FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT p.survivor_id,(SELECT p2.item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p2 JOIN
      (SELECT article_id,sum(length(body)) size FROM article_body_chunks GROUP BY article_id) z ON z.article_id=p2.item_id
      WHERE p2.survivor_id=p.survivor_id ORDER BY z.size DESC,p2.item_id DESC LIMIT 1) source_id
     FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p WHERE p.affected=1) g JOIN article_body_chunks b ON b.article_id=g.source_id

CREATE TEMP TABLE _wrss_original_body_copy AS SELECT g.survivor_id,b.chunk_index,b.body FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT p.survivor_id,(SELECT p2.item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p2 JOIN
      (SELECT article_id,sum(length(body)) size FROM article_original_chunks GROUP BY article_id) z ON z.article_id=p2.item_id
      WHERE p2.survivor_id=p.survivor_id ORDER BY z.size DESC,p2.item_id DESC LIMIT 1) source_id
     FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p WHERE p.affected=1) g JOIN article_original_chunks b ON b.article_id=g.source_id

CREATE TEMP TABLE _wrss_preview_copy AS SELECT g.survivor_id,p.summary,p.image_url FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT x.survivor_id,(SELECT x2.item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan x2 JOIN article_previews p2 ON p2.article_id=x2.item_id
      WHERE x2.survivor_id=x.survivor_id ORDER BY (p2.summary IS NOT NULL)+(p2.image_url IS NOT NULL) DESC,length(COALESCE(p2.summary,'')) DESC,x2.item_id DESC LIMIT 1) source_id
     FROM _wrss_dedup_plan x WHERE x.affected=1) g JOIN article_previews p ON p.article_id=g.source_id

CREATE TEMP TABLE _wrss_original_preview_copy AS SELECT g.survivor_id,p.summary,p.image_url FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT x.survivor_id,(SELECT x2.item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan x2 JOIN article_original_previews p2 ON p2.article_id=x2.item_id
      WHERE x2.survivor_id=x.survivor_id ORDER BY (p2.summary IS NOT NULL)+(p2.image_url IS NOT NULL) DESC,length(COALESCE(p2.summary,'')) DESC,x2.item_id DESC LIMIT 1) source_id
     FROM _wrss_dedup_plan x WHERE x.affected=1) g JOIN article_original_previews p ON p.article_id=g.source_id

CREATE TEMP TABLE _wrss_original_meta_copy AS SELECT g.survivor_id,m.source_url,m.fetched_at FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT x.survivor_id,(SELECT x2.item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan x2 JOIN article_original_meta m2 ON m2.article_id=x2.item_id
      WHERE x2.survivor_id=x.survivor_id ORDER BY m2.fetched_at DESC,x2.item_id DESC LIMIT 1) source_id
     FROM _wrss_dedup_plan x WHERE x.affected=1) g JOIN article_original_meta m ON m.article_id=g.source_id

CREATE TEMP TABLE _wrss_offline_copy AS SELECT p.survivor_id,max(o.media_type) media_type,o.origin_url,max(o.relative_path) relative_path,min(o.created_at) created_at
   FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p JOIN offline_media o ON o.item_id=p.item_id WHERE p.affected=1 GROUP BY p.survivor_id,o.origin_url

CREATE TEMP TABLE _wrss_cleanup_copy AS SELECT p.survivor_id,max(d.content_marker) content_marker FROM _wrss_dedup_plan p
   JOIN article_deletion_cleanup d ON d.item_id=p.item_id WHERE p.affected=1 GROUP BY p.survivor_id
UPDATE notes SET article_id=(SELECT survivor_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE item_id=notes.article_id) WHERE article_id IN(SELECT item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE affected=1)
UPDATE sync_saved_states SET item_id=(SELECT survivor_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE item_id=sync_saved_states.item_id) WHERE item_id IN(SELECT item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE affected=1)
UPDATE sync_article_ids SET item_id=NULL WHERE item_id IN(SELECT item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE affected=1)
DELETE FROM sync_article_aliases WHERE item_id IN(SELECT item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE affected=1)
DELETE FROM article_reading_state WHERE article_id IN(SELECT item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE affected=1)
DELETE FROM article_saved_states WHERE article_id IN(SELECT item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE affected=1)
DELETE FROM article_saved_entry_times WHERE article_id IN(SELECT item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE affected=1)
DELETE FROM article_body_chunks WHERE article_id IN(SELECT item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE affected=1)
DELETE FROM article_original_chunks WHERE article_id IN(SELECT item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE affected=1)
DELETE FROM article_previews WHERE article_id IN(SELECT item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE affected=1)
DELETE FROM article_original_previews WHERE article_id IN(SELECT item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE affected=1)
DELETE FROM article_original_meta WHERE article_id IN(SELECT item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE affected=1)

INSERT INTO article_saved_states SELECT * FROM _wrss_saved_copy
INSERT INTO article_saved_entry_times SELECT * FROM _wrss_saved_time_copy
INSERT INTO article_body_chunks SELECT * FROM _wrss_body_copy
INSERT INTO article_original_chunks SELECT * FROM _wrss_original_body_copy
INSERT INTO article_previews SELECT * FROM _wrss_preview_copy
INSERT INTO article_original_previews SELECT * FROM _wrss_original_preview_copy
INSERT INTO article_original_meta SELECT * FROM _wrss_original_meta_copy
INSERT INTO offline_media(item_id,media_type,origin_url,relative_path,created_at) SELECT * FROM _wrss_offline_copy

UPDATE articles SET reading_progress=COALESCE((SELECT progress FROM article_reading_state WHERE article_id=articles.id),reading_progress),
    is_saved=COALESCE((SELECT saved FROM article_saved_states WHERE article_id=articles.id AND save_type='favorite'),is_saved)
   WHERE id IN(SELECT survivor_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE affected=1)

INSERT INTO sync_article_ids(article_id,item_id,url) SELECT i.article_id,i.survivor_id,COALESCE(a.link,p.target_key)
   FROM _wrss_identity_choice i JOIN articles a ON a.id=i.survivor_id JOIN _wrss_dedup_plan p ON p.item_id=i.survivor_id
   WHERE 1 ON CONFLICT(article_id) DO UPDATE SET item_id=excluded.item_id,url=CASE WHEN (SELECT link FROM articles WHERE id=excluded.item_id) IS NULL THEN sync_article_ids.url ELSE excluded.url END
INSERT INTO sync_article_aliases(item_id,article_id) SELECT survivor_id,article_id FROM _wrss_identity_choice
DELETE FROM articles WHERE id IN(SELECT item_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE item_id<>survivor_id)
UPDATE articles SET dedup_key=char(0)||'wrss-dedup:'||id WHERE id IN(SELECT survivor_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE affected=1)

UPDATE articles SET dedup_key=(SELECT target_key FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE survivor_id=articles.id ORDER BY CASE WHEN old_key=target_key THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,item_id LIMIT 1)
   WHERE id IN(SELECT survivor_id FROM _wrss_dedup_plan WHERE affected=1)

INSERT INTO sync_change_log(kind,entity_id,changed_at,origin_device_id,reason,created_at)
   SELECT 'article',i.article_id,?,COALESCE((SELECT device_id FROM sync_local_identity WHERE id=1),(SELECT source_device_id FROM sync_saved_states WHERE article_id=i.article_id ORDER BY changed_at DESC LIMIT 1),'dedup-migration'),'dedupMigration',?
   FROM _wrss_identity_choice i

CREATE TRIGGER sync_article_alias_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF article_id ON sync_article_aliases WHEN OLD.article_id!=NEW.article_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Article alias already bound to another identity'); END

CREATE TRIGGER sync_article_binding_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF item_id ON sync_article_ids WHEN OLD.item_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.item_id IS NOT NULL AND OLD.item_id!=NEW.item_id AND NOT (
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sync_article_aliases WHERE item_id=OLD.item_id AND article_id=OLD.article_id) AND
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sync_article_aliases al JOIN articles a ON a.id=al.item_id WHERE al.item_id=NEW.item_id AND al.article_id=NEW.article_id AND a.dedup_key=NEW.article_id AND a.link IS NEW.url)
   ) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Article id already bound to another item'); END

CREATE TRIGGER sync_article_insert_binding_immutable BEFORE INSERT ON sync_article_ids WHEN NEW.item_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sync_article_ids WHERE article_id=NEW.article_id AND item_id IS NOT NULL AND item_id!=NEW.item_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Article id already bound to another item'); END
